caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces 22 kt Winds, 75% Rain Probability
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing sustained winds of up to 22 kt, waves reaching 5.6 ft, and a dominant 8-second swell from the ENE. The forecast also indicates 75% rain probability, while St. Lucia sees 10-kt winds.

mediterranean.headline: Venice Faces Strong Winds, Heavy Rain Forecast
mediterranean.paragraph: Venice is experiencing sustained winds of up to 12 kt and wave heights of 2.1 ft, with a 62% rain probability. Cadiz will see winds up to 20 kt, but no significant swell or rainfall is forecast there.
